ABOUT EERO

Heal. Grow. Thrive.

Eero Therapeutic Services supports children, young people, and families in New Jersey with personalized behavioral and mental-health services. Founded in 2020 by Oluwakemi (Kemi) Idowu, Eero takes its name from the Yoruba word for calm.

Try the simple intake →

Care with a purpose.

Our mission is to help families, youth, and children reach their potential through individualized behavioral support.

Our vision is to inspire change and improve quality of life for individuals, families, groups, and the wider community.

Our work emphasizes emotional wellbeing, practical life skills, family and school partnerships, and a supportive space for growth.

Our services

  • Biopsychosocial needs assessment
  • Intensive In-Community services (IIC)
  • Behavioral Assistance services (BA)
  • Parent coaching
  • Youth mentoring
  • Parent mentoring
  • Social skills group
  • Tween group
  • Girls group
  • Boys group
  • Grief group
  • Parenting group
  • Summer program services

Contact Eero to discuss the service that fits your needs, current availability, eligibility, and payment or coverage questions.
